title: fix(package-extensions): do not match ranged selectors on synthesized version (pnpm/pnpm#15007)
body: ## Summary When an archive or local tarball dependency contains no `package.json`, pnpm synthesizes a fallback manifest with version `0.0.0` for lockfile and CAS storage. Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need. Autofix is disabled. ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **Bug Fixes** * Fixed `packageExtensions` version-range selectors so they don’t match dependencies without a version in their manifest. * Bare package-name selectors still apply to these dependencies, while range selectors continue to match packages with an explicit `0.0.0` version. * The fix applies to package installation and dependency resolution.
